description: Causal model — what actually moves stocks. Sector rotation paths by regime, news catalyst taxonomy with typical magnitudes, time-of-day patterns. Used by voice tools to reason about WHY things move, not just observe THAT they moved.

sector_rotation.description: Four-stage business cycle rotation (Stovall / Murphy framework). At any given point, certain sectors typically lead while others lag.

early_bull.description: Just past a market low — early expansion. Rates falling or low, sentiment recovering.
early_bull.regime_signal: bull_trend with rising breadth from low base

mid_bull.description: Mid-cycle expansion — earnings growing, broad participation.

late_bull.description: Late-cycle — economy strong, inflation pressure, Fed tightening risk. Quality leadership narrows.
late_bull.regime_signal: distribution or late bull_trend with narrowing leadership

early_recovery.description: Bear ending — first signs of breadth thrust.

catalyst_taxonomy.description: News and event catalysts ranked by typical price impact and persistence. Magnitudes are rules-of-thumb; actual moves vary by name and regime.

catalysts.title: Earnings beat with raised guidance
catalysts.notes: The strongest single catalyst. Gap usually holds and trends for weeks. Watch for institutional accumulation in first 3-5 days.

catalysts.title: Earnings beat with in-line guidance
catalysts.notes: Mildly positive but the lack of guidance raise often fades the initial pop within days.

catalysts.title: Earnings miss
catalysts.notes: Most punishing in late-cycle. Misses tend to compound — stocks often have 2-3 down legs over weeks.

catalysts.title: Forward guidance cut
catalysts.notes: Cuts predict future cuts. Avoid catching the falling knife — wait for a base.

catalysts.title: Analyst upgrade
catalysts.notes: Usually a 1-day pop that fades. Tier-1 firms (Goldman, MS, JPM) have bigger impact than tier-3. Multiple-firm upgrades in a week are more durable.

catalysts.title: Analyst downgrade
catalysts.notes: Usually fades. Multiple downgrades together signal real change.

catalysts.title: FDA drug approval
catalysts.notes: Binary biotech event. Small caps can double; large caps less. Tends to gap-and-go.

catalysts.title: FDA rejection / CRL
catalysts.notes: Devastating for small biotechs. Hard to recover without a re-submission.

catalysts.title: Acquisition target announced
catalysts.notes: Stock pins near deal price after the initial gap. Spread captures arbitrage premium. Risk: deal break.

catalysts.title: Acquirer in announced deal
catalysts.notes: Acquirers usually sell off (dilution + integration risk) unless deal is highly accretive.

catalysts.title: Stock split announcement
catalysts.notes: Historically priced in fast; modern splits often spark momentum into the split date.

catalysts.title: Dividend increase or initiation
catalysts.notes: Small persistent positive — signals capital return commitment. Income funds buy.

catalysts.title: Buyback authorization
catalysts.notes: Mildly positive. Size of buyback as % of market cap matters more than the headline.

catalysts.title: CEO/CFO unexpected departure
catalysts.notes: Sharp initial sell-off unless replacement is highly regarded. Don't catch the knife day 1.

catalysts.title: Regulatory/fraud investigation
catalysts.notes: Often the first chapter of a multi-year decline. Survival of these names is rare. Avoid completely.

catalysts.title: Fed pivot to easier policy
catalysts.notes: Broad market impact — small caps + financials + rate-sensitive sectors benefit most. First cut often marks a regime change.

catalysts.title: Fed hawkish surprise
catalysts.notes: Hurts long-duration assets first (tech, growth, biotech).

time_of_day.description: Intraday timing patterns affecting trade quality and reversal frequency.

patterns.label: Opening drive
patterns.behavior: Highest volume of day, widest spreads. Overnight orders clear. Setups can reverse 30-60 min in. Best for high-conviction breakouts, not exploration.

patterns.label: Morning continuation
patterns.behavior: If opening drive holds, trends often extend in this window. Best entries for swing setups.

patterns.label: Lunch chop
patterns.behavior: Volume drops, ranges contract. Most intraday strategies underperform. Wait or take partials.

patterns.label: Afternoon trend
patterns.behavior: Volume rebuilds. Trend days resume direction; reversal days fail their morning move.

patterns.label: MOC / close
patterns.behavior: Institutional rebalancing. MOC imbalance feeds visible at 3:50. Heavy MOC buy/sell can spike or dump prices in last 10 minutes.

patterns.label: After-hours
patterns.behavior: Earnings releases. Spreads 3-10x wider. Moves can be exaggerated or reverse fully by next open. AH lows often retest at the cash open.
